heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy, with some patchy river valley fog developing overnight. Lows in the low to mid 60s, nearing 70 along Lake Champlain. Light south wind.

heading: Sunday
text: Mostly cloudy, with rain showers arriving as early as midday in western Vermont, then spreading east. Chance of thunderstorms developing in the afternoon. Highs from the low to mid 80s. Wind becoming south at 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Widespread rain, with a chance of evening thunderstorms. Lows in the low to mid 60s, a few 50s in the cold spots. Light south wind.
